plugins.name: the-foreman
plugins.description: Gated development conductor: preflight rails, lifecycle gates enforced via render-then-ask, secret-scanned Artifact briefs, and a right-sized subagent dispatch policy. Bundles codex-gate (independent Codex second-reviewer gate), handoff, keep-it-simple, the-refiner, and the-cartographer (source-derived system maps + doc-vs-code drift audit).
